review_kind: Assistant editorial inspection of automatic sketch; not user acceptance or final history fact-check

issues.problem: Territorial peak is presented as established before the chapter starting 1658; the brief does not establish this claim.
issues.correction: Enter from the succession rupture and changes of patronage documented in the brief; later campaigns and fiscal effects remain research questions, not established causes of decline.

issues.problem: Orthodox policies, decline of courtly arts and beginning of political fragmentation imply a singular, pre-decided decline story from an arts-heavy brief.
issues.correction: Distinguish documented succession and patronage changes from disputed political causation. Ask how military commitments, administration and regional agency interacted; retain explicit research gaps.

issues.problem: At 1757 the emperor is called a figurehead although F11 supports nominal emperors under British protection in the nineteenth century.
issues.correction: Enter with growing regional autonomy and weakened central control; retain continuing Mughal legitimacy. Establish nineteenth-century nominal status in C07.

issues.problem: Restoration by Humayun and Akbar still conflates the restoration with the later accession.
issues.correction: Describe Humayun restoring the dynasty and Akbar succeeding him in 1556.

issues.problem: All card briefs copy a generic instruction without identifying a relevant scene.
issues.correction: Specify a distinct chapter-relevant generated scene to select from the incoming chapter approved assets; native title/date overlays and no new card-only generation.

issues.problem: The style is generic; artwork/portrait instructions could depend on archival scans and unavailable footage.
issues.correction: Specify a coherent historical illustration style for all generated scene imagery, subject-grounded palettes, stable geography/banner treatment and native overlays. Explicitly describe generated reconstructions/studies; do not request footage, scans or authentic historical document reproductions.
